title: MONTBLANC BACKPACK & TOILETRY ...
reason: Montblanc leather backpack with matching pouch in clean condition; the backpack alone usually resells for several hundred dollars.
findings: Black textured leather backpack with the Montblanc white star emblem on the front pocket, zip-around compartments, padded mesh back and straps, plus a separate blue leather pouch/toiletry bag with a matching star emblem. Close-up of the black leather shows a fine cross-hatch (Saffiano-type) print, consistent with the Montblanc Sartorial range, but the model is not named in the photos. Inside the main compartment is a black cross-hatch leather tag reading MONTBLANC / MADE IN ITALY, and the lining is black jacquard with a repeating MONTBLANC wordmark. A white tag hangs near the top handle but its text is not legible. No serial or date code visible. The photos support the Montblanc claim (emblem, label, lining) though authenticity cannot be proven from photos. Price check: pre-owned Montblanc Sartorial backpacks were listed on a luxury resale site at about $566 to $621 (theluxurycloset.com listings p264484 and p1401607, seen in search results 19/10/2026, currency not confirmed); new price is much higher.
condition: Looks near new to very good: leather clean with no visible scuffs or corner wear, zips and straps look intact, interior clean. Pouch clean. Back panel and straps not closely examined beyond the photos.
rescore_note: Black cross-hatch leather backpack with matching blue pouch, and the Montblanc emblem, MADE IN ITALY label and wordmark lining all look consistent with genuine Sartorial range, near new; pre-owned Sartorial backpacks were listed at $553 to $705 (theluxurycloset.com, seen 19/10/2026, currency not confirmed) against US$1,750 new (montblanc.com), so my estimate is $350 to $600 allowing for some fake risk.
